args.expect: Both frames show an orbital platform in open space, lit at noon and dark at midnight.
args.prompt: These two frames are the same RimWorld map at local noon and local midnight, on an Odyssey orbital platform 200km above latitude 45. Confirm: (1) the surroundings outside the square platform are open space, not planet terrain — no grass, soil, rock or water anywhere; (2) the noon frame is brightly lit and the walls cast visible shadows; (3) the midnight frame is substantially darker than the noon frame. Fail if the map looks like a planet surface.
